rule.text: On Foundry, the MMD correction default moves from azure-openai/gpt-5.6-sol to azure-openai/gpt-6.1-sol when the Q3-D5 rule holds (clean mechanical screen, no worse in the blinded errors-first reading, cheaper); the Foundry Context default stays azure-openai/gpt-5.6-sol.
